prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA leads trend correlation (0.0) among models with comparable trend tracking, while ONLY_CWT_rf dominates seasonality capture (0.6715). ONLY_FT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (585.87), but early/late horizon specialists differ significantly (ONLY_DWT_rf at 412.51 vs catboost at 535.90). The extreme RMSE spread (26.31) and high seasonality variance (0.99) indicate substantial model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling the divergent trend/seasonality champions.
